name: The War Zone (TWZ)
desc: Defense news outlet with deep drone/UAS, counter-drone and EW reporting across all warfare domains.

name: Drone Wars UK
desc: UK NGO researching armed drones, autonomous weapons and drone proliferation; strike and crash databases.

name: Unmanned Airspace
desc: Information portal for UTM, UAM and counter-UAS systems with daily industry and C-UAS news.

name: DroneXL
desc: Drone industry news hub covering DJI, regulation, counter-drone tech and conflict UAS developments.

name: DroneLife
desc: Long-running drone industry news site covering commercial, defense and regulatory developments.

name: Unmanned Systems Technology
desc: Trade publication on UAV, UGV and unmanned systems news, components and detection technology.

name: Militarnyi (English)
desc: Ukrainian military news outlet with extensive drone-warfare and OSINT coverage of the Russia-Ukraine war.

name: Drone Warfare (drone-warfare.com)
desc: Open-source analysis platform for unmanned systems in conflict; C-UAS, EW and platform profiles via DWIM.

name: CNAS Proliferated Drones
desc: CNAS project and interactive database on global drone proliferation, capabilities and policy.

name: Center for the Study of the Drone (Bard)
desc: Archival academic center; Drone Databook and 530+ counter-drone systems database (inactive since 2020).

name: Janes OSINT Defence News
desc: Janes open-source defence intelligence including UAS, EW and C4ISR analysis and capability data.

name: Armada International - Electronic Warfare
desc: EW section (Thomas Withington) covering jamming, spectrum, radar and counter-drone electronic warfare.

name: GPSJAM (John Wiseman)
desc: Daily global maps of GPS/GNSS interference derived from ADS-B aircraft navigation-accuracy data.

name: GPSwise / SkAI Data Services Live Map
desc: Real-time GPS spoofing and jamming map from ADS-B data, by SkAI Data Services (ZHAW).

name: OPSGROUP
desc: Flight-ops community tracking GPS spoofing/jamming in civil aviation; spoofing workgroup reports and maps.

name: RNT Foundation (RNTF)
desc: Resilient Navigation and Timing Foundation; news and advocacy on GPS/GNSS interference and resilience.

name: ADS-B Exchange
desc: Unfiltered crowd-sourced flight tracking; underlying data source for GPS-interference detection analyses.

name: D-Fend Drone Attack & Incident Tracker
desc: Filterable global tracker of drone attacks and incidents by country, sector and incident type.

name: DroneSec
desc: Drone threat-intelligence firm; DroneSec Notify aggregates 100+ sources on UAS/C-UAS incidents and trends.

name: ExpressLRS Project
desc: Open-source FPV/UAS RC link project; tracks the de facto ELRS control-link standard and community trends.

name: IEEE Spectrum
desc: Engineering publication with in-depth reporting on electronic warfare, drone tech and counter-drone systems.
